rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with secure file system operations through a complete set of tools for reading, writing, copying, moving, and deleting files, plus directory management and advanced search capabilities including regex pattern matching and content searching across files. Built by Jihad Khawaja using .NET 8.0 and C# 12.0, it features Docker support, structured JSON responses, path validation to prevent directory traversal attacks, and comprehensive error handling. Serves developers needing AI-powered file management automation, teams requiring programmatic file system access through conversational interfaces, and applications that need to perform bulk file operations while maintaining security through proper path validation and permission respect.
